name: what-would-make-this-easier
description: Output-shaping skills for a reader who chose them: 16 condition skills, the needs picker, 2 learning and communication skills, and 12 per-area skills. Nothing infers, stores or displays a condition.

interface.shortDescription: Presentation settings the reader chooses, one skill each
interface.longDescription: Skills that change how Codex lays out, paces and words its answers, chosen by the reader by area or by a label they already use. Every skill loads only when named. None grants permission or stands in for a confirmation.
